canonical_statement: For every number field K and every smooth, projective, geometrically connected curve C over K whose geometric genus is greater than one, the full type C(K) of K-rational points is finite.
domain_and_universes: universe u; K : Type u with Field K and NumberField K; C : CurveOver K contains only a concrete Scheme.{u} and its morphism to Spec K; StructureSheafH1 C.scheme : Type u is concrete pinned sheaf cohomology; the target is Prop.
hypotheses: C is smooth of relative dimension one over Spec K
C is projective over Spec K via a closed immersion into a finite projective space
C remains connected under every field-valued base change
for some n > 1, the underlying additive group of the concrete H^1(C, O_C) is equivalent to the additive group of K^n
conclusion: Finite (RationalPoint C.scheme C.structureMap), where RationalPoint is the full subtype of sections Spec K -> C over the identity of Spec K.
minimal_import_basis: Geometrically.Basic supplies geometrically; Modules.Sheaf supplies Scheme.Modules, the structure sheaf module, and its underlying abelian sheaf; Morphisms.Smooth supplies SmoothOfRelativeDimension and the homogeneous-polynomial surface used with Proj at this pin; ProjectiveSpectrum.Basic supplies Proj, its degree-zero structure map, and transitively the closed-immersion and Over-category APIs; SheafCohomology.Basic supplies Sheaf.H; GrothendieckCategory.HasExt and Topology.Sheaves.Abelian jointly discharge the concrete HasExt obligation for H; NumberField.Basic supplies NumberField. Removing any one of these eight imports from the final source fails elaboration. Initially explicit ClosedImmersion, Over.Basic, and MvPolynomial.Homogeneous imports were removable and were deleted.
encoding_boundary: The pinned snapshot supplies concrete schemes, morphisms, relative smoothness/dimension, geometric connectedness, projective spectra, closed immersions, the structure sheaf as a module sheaf, and abelian sheaf cohomology. IsProjectiveOver is defined by a closed immersion into finite projective space. StructureSheafH1 is the actual pinned H^1(X, O_X) type. HasGeometricGenus K X n is expressed as an additive equivalence H^1(X, O_X) ≃+ K^n. For a number field, additive maps are automatically rational-linear and finite rational dimensions make n the expected K-dimension when H^1 carries its standard K-action. The pin does not expose that K-linear cohomology action or its native dimension API, so this comparison remains explicit M3 normalization debt, but the predicate is derived from the actual scheme and cannot be satisfied by choosing an unconstrained Prop or Nat field. CurveOver stores no genus datum and no conclusion.

degenerate_and_boundary_cases: Genus zero and genus one are excluded by existence of n with 1 < n in the concrete H^1 characterization. Non-number-field bases, singular or non-relative-dimension-one schemes, nonprojective schemes, and geometrically disconnected curves are excluded. Empty curves are not separately excluded by the formal target; whether the primary-source curve convention entails nonemptiness is part of the H4 source audit. No effective bound, enumeration, or uniformity claim is included.
